name: constraints-dsl-compiler
description: Typescript compiler for the constraints DSL

scripts.build: rm -rf build && tsc && npm run build:guest-libs
scripts.generate-doc: rm -rf build/docs && npx typedoc src/libs/constraints-edsl-fluent-api.ts --excludePrivate --excludeInternal --out ./build/docs --name "Constraints eDSL Documentation" --readme none --gitRevision develop --validation.notExported false --logLevel Warn
